summary: Build the Reconnaissance primitive: a per-player, per-province boolean (ProvinceState.Reconnaissance), HasReconnaissance/GrantReconnaissance, and an enemy-province targeting shape keyed by index rather than a card id. It clears only when the battle at that province resolves (ResolveBattle, regardless of outcome) -- a province refilling with a new card or being destroyed does not clear it on its own. Training fixture (training-scout) exercises granting and a Reconnaissance-gated Battle effect ahead of any real card needing it. Shared-file change: docs/ROADMAP.md is the cross-lane living checklist by design; all code changes are rules-lane engine-only, no client files touched.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: 74/74 core tests (2 new: Reconnaissance, ReconnaissanceOnlyClearsOnBattleResolution), 33/33 published, 8/8 deck-format, plus AI/server/client-transport checks -- all pass.
remaining: No published card exercises it yet; no UI surfacing; AbilityActions()'s generic action-discovery query does not yet enumerate province-index targets (only matters once a real card needs it).
